title: Tech that changed the world

slides.title: What is technology?
slides.text: Technology is anything people invent to solve a problem. A tablet is technology. So are paper and a pencil.
slides.alt: Would you rather: every lesson on a tablet, or every lesson on paper?

slides.title: Tech changes how we live
slides.text: The telephone let people talk from far away. Video calls let families see each other every day. Maps on a device changed how people find their way.
slides.alt: Would you rather: video-call a relative far away every day, or visit them once a month?

focus.cue: Video calls: see family far away every day
Or visit them once a month

slides.title: Plus and minus
slides.text: Every invention is a tradeoff. It makes something easier and changes something else.
steps: plus: see your cousin far away
minus: you need a device and a connection

slides.title: People change tech too
slides.text: People change technology right back. Captions were added to videos because viewers asked for them. Designers still add changes like that when someone struggles.
slides.alt: Pick two changes that would help Ana: bigger text, a bigger Play button, captions for sounds, read the menu aloud and more.

focus.cue: Changes designers can make for Ana
Captions for sounds: a change people asked for

words.means: anything people invent to solve a problem
you get one good thing but give up another

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Pick one invention you use every day. Think of one way it changed how people live, and one thing it made harder. Then talk about it.
slides.alt: Would you rather: a map app that picks your route, or a paper map and your own choices?

focus.cue: One invention you use: a map app
What did it change? What got harder?

talk: Which invention would you un-invent for a week? What would be better, and what would be worse?
